name: every tag form and a splice, block style
yaml:
kind: Telo.Definition
metadata:
  name: Jobs
resources:
  - !for-each
    metadata:
      name: crons
    in: !cel "self.jobs"
    emit:
      kind: Scheduler.Cron
      schedule: !cel "each.value.schedule"
  - kind: Http.Api
    metadata:
      name: api
    routes:
      - !if
        if: !cel "self.admin"
        then:
          path: /admin
        else:
          path: /public
      - !switch
        switch: !cel "self.mode"
        cases:
          a:
            path: /a
        default:
          path: /other
    columns:
      id: integer
      ...: !for-each
        in: !cel "self.fields"
        key: !cel "each.key"
        emit: text
    target: !ref "stores[each.key]"
